parameters.help_en:
The device information used to create a log retrieval task in USER mode. The field type is String, and the content format is a JSON array string. Each object in the array represents the information of a device from which logs are to be retrieved.
appVersion String: the version of the application.
os String: the operating system name or platform identifier of the device.
ip String: the IP address of the device client.
updateTime Long: the time when the device information was last updated, in milliseconds (UNIX timestamp).
userName String: the nickname or username of the device user.
deviceId String: the unique identifier of the device, used to locate the device for log retrieval.
userId String: the user ID on the business side.
clientTime Long: the client time of the device, in milliseconds (UNIX timestamp).
geo String: the geographic information of the device, typically in the format of country-province-city.
osVersion String: the operating system version.
conType Integer: the connection type. 0 indicates unknown. 1 indicates an in-app persistent connection or main process persistent connection. 2 indicates a silent persistent connection or non-main process persistent connection.
appId String: the unique identifier of the application, typically in the format of <AppKey>@<Os>.
online Boolean: indicates whether the device is online.
appKey String: the AppKey of the application.
serverTime Long: the time when the server recorded the device information, in milliseconds (UNIX timestamp).
deviceModel String: the model of the device.
brand String: the brand of the device
parameters.help_zh:
DeviceJson 用于创建 USER 模式的日志回捞任务，字段类型为 String，内容格式为 JSON 数组字符串。数组中的每个对象表示一台待回捞日志的设备信息
appVersion String 应用版本号
os String 设备操作系统名称或平台标识
ip String 设备客户端 IP 地址
updateTime Long 设备信息更新时间，毫秒时间戳
userName String 设备用户昵称/用户名
deviceId String 设备唯一标识，用于定位日志回捞设备
userId String 业务侧用户 ID
clientTime Long 设备客户端时间，毫秒时间戳
geo String 设备地域信息，通常格式为国家-省份-城市
osVersion String 操作系统版本
conType Integer 连接类型，0 表示未知，1 表示应用内长连接/主进程长连接，2 表示静默长连接/非主进程长连接
appId String 应用唯一标识，通常格式为 <AppKey>@<Os>
online Boolean 设备是否在线
appKey String 应用 AppKey
serverTime Long 服务端记录设备信息的时间，毫秒时间戳
deviceModel String 设备型号
brand String 设备品牌
parameters.name: device_json

parameters.help_en: The notification configuration in JSON format. If specified, this value is saved to the task
